tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab mo yang tig gi bka' srung drag po sum sgril bzhugs so/ /dpal gyi srung ma'i sgrub thabs drag po sum sgril zhes bya ba/ sngags bdag dam can rgya mtsho thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed 'das pa'i dus na sngon byung ba/ /dpal gyi 'khor tshogs srung ma dam tshig can/ / sngags bdag gza' dang dam can zhabs btud de/ /de yi dril sgrub gsang ba'i yang khol bri/ /'di la gnyis te/ sngon du bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa dang*/ de'i las sbyor bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bris sku'am gsang ba'i rgyud lung man ngag gi rten gyi drung du/ tshogs dang gtor ma dang mchod pa ci 'byor du bshams la/ bdag nyid bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa byas la/ yi dam gang mos dbyings kyi kun tu bzang po yab yum mthing ga mnyam gzhag can du bsgoms la/ snang srid thams cad 'od lnga ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i ngang las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzlas pa ni bdag gi rnal 'byor te/ lha mchog thams cad kyi rje dpon rgyal por bdag nyid sgrub bo/ /de nas bdag gi bka' nyan pa'i tshul du bka' sdod srung mar bsgrubs pa ni/ e las nam mkha' 'byams klas pa'i ngang du yaṃ las rlung nag 'khrugs pa'i dkyil du/ raṃ las me'i klong chen por/ laṃ las ye shes 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang rak+ta'i dba' klong 'khrugs shing thod mkhar gyi ri rab brtsegs pa'i nang du/ 'bar ba chen po'i klong*/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan/ zhing chen bsgyel ba'i steng du/ ma tri tri/ smug nag /ljang nag /dmar nag yongs su gyur pa las/ sku bskyed pa ni/ ma las dbus su sngags kyi bdag mo smug nag zhal gcig spyan gcig tshems gcig ral pa gcig ma/ phyag g.yas zhing dbyug rgyal mtshan 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas snying dang rgyu zhags 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gcer bur bzhengs pa/ thal chen zhag gi zo ris byas pa/

thod phreng mi mgo'i rgyan chas mdzes pa/ zhing lpags g.yang gzhi stod la dkris pa/ dpa' brjid rngam zhing 'od zer 'phro ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du ma smug nag 'od 'phro bar bsam mo/ /de'i g.yas su tri ljang nag las/ gza' bdud chen po ljang nag 'bar ba/ sku smad dug sbrul kun tu 'khyil ba/ sku stod zhal dgu shin tu rngam pa/ phyag g.yas mda' dang chu srin rgyal mtshan/ g.yon pas gzhu dang sbrul zhags bsnams pa/ spyan stong bskal pa'i me dpung 'bar ba/ steng na bya rog kang ka sgrogs pa/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su tri ljang las 'od zer kun nas 'phro bar bsam mo/ /g.yon du tri las skyes mchog dam can dmar nag zhal gcig spyan gsum bgrad pa/ thod phreng mi mgo'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu gsor ba/ g.yon pas mi snying zhal du gsol ba/ zhing lpags rlon pas stod dkris byas pa/ stag sham sku yi smad du dkris pa/ seng ge dkar mo chibs su bcibs pa/ thugs kar nyi steng tri dmar 'phro ba/ brjid rngam drag po'i 'od zer 'phro bar bsam mo/ / de'i mtha' bskor du lha srin sde brgyad 'jig rten pa'i 'khor tshogs sku mdog dang cha lugs sna tshogs su gsal ba sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam dang*/ bdud bya dang ce sbyang dang*/ stag gzig dang dom dred dang*/ khyi nag la sogs pa pho nya yang sprul las mkhan dang bcas pa tshad med pa'i 'phro 'du skar mda' 'khrugs pa tsam bsam mo/ /de thams cad kyang bdag gi bka' nyan cing gsung sgrub la thugs brtse bar bsam mo/ /de nas/ ā+oṃ ma ma trag rak+ṣa tri tri ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ dza dza/ zhes bdun brjod pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas sngar bsgoms pa kho na 'dra ba'i ye shes pa byon nas de la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ snying po de nyid ci 'grub bzlas pas lha gsum gyi thugs ka'i ma tri tri las 'od zer 'phros gnod byed thams cad gtubs pas rengs shing brgyal bar gyur/

'jig rten gyi dregs byed thams cad ky-i nus pa dus gcig bsdus thugs kar thim pas gzi brjid du 'bar/ 'khor gyi dregs pa can rnams las la bskul/ bdag gis phrin las ci bsgo sgrub pa la bran bzhin gyur/ snang srid thams cad dus gcig la g.yo ldeg 'phar bar bsams la skad cig kyang ma yengs pas/ sngags dang dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du la brtson par bya'o thun rdzas gtor ma raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg gtor sbyangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sha khrag gi ri dang rgya mtshor bsams la/ rtsa sngags kyi gsham du ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags la lnga 'am bdun gyis phul bas/ gtso 'khor rnams kyis gsol bas mnyes par bsams la dam tshig bskul ba ni/ rdo rje bka' dar gyi dam la gnas pa bu bzhin skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ ma sring dbang phyug 'bar ma 'khor bcas/ tshur gshegs e h+ye hi rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bcol ba'i phrin las gnyan po sgrubs shig /ces brjod la/ bstod pas kyang bstod nas/ slar gsal gdab la bsngo ba bya'o/ /de ltar thun bzhi'am srod la thun cher byas pas dngos su thog 'tsheg /'od 'phro sgo brdung sgra skad grag /byin 'ur bag bro/ dpa' gding skye/ gzi byin la dang por 'jigs 'ub 'ub pa las rjes la dga' yas yal 'ong*/ rmi lam dang por 'tshubs la 'jigs pa/ sa g.yo/ thog dang skar mda' 'khrugs/ ri ldeg /dmag dpung 'khrugs/ sems can gsod pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ rjes la bud med kyi khrom 'dus nas phyag 'tshal/ skyes pa'i tshogs kyis phyag 'tshal/ gdan khri chen po la rang 'dug khrom 'dus nas mngon par bstod pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang 'tshig cing mi dga' na dmigs pa rgya bskyed tshogs gtor bskang bshags bya'o/ /rmi lam du smyon pa byung na ma chun pas rang nyid drag po'i lhar bskyed pa'am/ lta ba'i gding gis thams cad rang sems stong pa'i ngang du la bzla'o/ /mdze pho dang yugs sar byung na dam tshig nyams pas bskang bshags bya/

sprang po byung na tshogs gtor gyis bskang ngo*/ rtag tu skong mchod la brtson pas ci bsam 'grub pa yin no/ /sngon du bsnyen zhing sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa drag po'i las la sbyor ba la/ rdzas bca' la/ sgom bzlas bya ba/ las mtha' brtul ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni brag phug byang shar du lta ba'am/ 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum mda' gang ba/ rosol gyis byugs pa'i steng du/ ma ṭaṃ gi snying gar 'brub khung gru gsum gyi nang du/ dgra'i ling ga ming rus mtshangs gsum bris pa tha jas bskor ba/ dgug gzhug yang yang byas pa/ shi skras bcings pa bcug la/ lcags kyi 'khor khang mun nag 'khor mthar dus med par dgra bo tshud par bsam/ de'i steng du rtag gtor gru gsum dmar gyis brgyan pa lha gsum du bskyed pas mnan la bzhag /liṅga gcig rang gi mal 'og du dong gru gsum brus par gzhug /des ni bdag gi dbang du byed cing 'phags mi nus la/ kho'i srung ma rang gshed la bab pa'i gnad do/ /thun la lcags zangs 'khar ba'i phye ma dug sna khrag sna nyung dkar dang bcas pa'i thun dong bya/ dmar gtor zur pa re yang thun rjes la btang zhing rbad du bya'o/ /sgom bzlas bya ba ni bdag nyid ye shes kyi ma mo sngar bskyed pa ltar stong khams gang ba sku che la yan lag rags par bskyed la/ ā+oṃ ma ma tra raka mo ta keṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pas/ stong khams kyi dregs pa'i dbang phyug thams cad

snga ngas 'dar skrag bka' nyan pa'i/ sprul pa 'bum gyi las mkhan shan pa ming sring gsum du gyur te/ ma tri tri las sngar bskyed pa lta bur khros shing rngam la thog dang mtshon gyi skar mda' dgra'i steng du 'bebs par rdul phran bzhin du song/ sprul pa'i 'phro 'dus dgra bo yul 'khor dang bcas pa mdun du bkug nas tho bas brdung mtshon chas 'debs/ rlung gis gtor bar bsam zhing*/ ā+oṃ ma ma tri tri rak+ṣa che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭa: ma tri dza ma tri dza/ hur thums rbad ri li li/ mā ra ya mā ra ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ /ces rig pa ngar bskyed la drag tu bzlas/ thun zhabs su 'brub khung gi liṅga thun gyis brab cing drag sngags de nyid zhe sdang gi ngar bskyed la bzlas/ de nas dmar gtor dgra'i sha khrag tu bsams la/ ā+oṃ ma ma tri tri rak+ṣa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa bdun gyis phul la/ hūṃ khams gsum kun gyi gtso mo ni/ khrag 'thung 'bar ma ral gcig ma/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /'jigs pa'i gza' bdud rā hu la/ /zhe sdang 'bar ba'i khrag 'thung gtso/ /sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /shan pa mi bsrun 'jigs pa'i sku/ /skyes mchog badz+ra thig le rtsal/ /dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sdang byed dgra bo 'dir sgrol zhig /'khor gyi ma sring sde brgyad tshogs/ /pho nya yang sprul za byed rnams/ / sha khrag gtor ma 'di longs la/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzod cig /che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa phaṭaḥces brjod do/ /thal mo gdab/ dmod bcol bya'o/ /de ltar zhag bdun bsgrub cing las la sbyar bas/ rmi lam du rdo gshag pa/ shing gcod pa/ lings byed pa rnams 'byung ste 'grub pa'i rtags so/ /gal te rtags 'gyangs na/ srog sngags dkrugs la gtor ma dang ling ga gnyis ka thun gyis brab pas/ cho 'phrul la zad pa med/ 'jigs sdangs la tshugs pa med/

de lta ba'i ngar bskyed la ma zhum par bya'o/ /phaṭa phaṭaḥ ma ma ya tri dza dzaḥ hūṃ hūṃ rak+ṣa tri tri dzaḥ chai ge'i srog la hur thu mas dzaḥ rbad ya rbad yaḥ ri li ri li zhes pa'o/ / 'di ni shin tu drag po'i las mtha'o/ /dmigs gnad ming sring gsum mgo rting log /'khor rnams phan tshun 'khrugs/ sde brgyad nang 'thabs/ mtshon gyi skar mda' 'khrugs/ khrag gi bu yug langs/ dgra bo 'khor bcas phung bar bsam mo/ kha thaṃ/ gsum pa las kyi mtha' brtul ba ni/ rtags phyung nas ling ga mtshon gyis gtubs la/ tsher ma'i hom sbar ba'i nang du lha gsum 'khor bcas bskyed pa'i zhal du phul bas las 'grub par bsam/ lha gshegs thal ba bsdus/ rtag gtor dgra phyogs su zor du 'phangs pas/ ma sring 'khor bcas dgra yul du dmag dpung chas nas rdul phran bzhin du bcom/ nad dang mtshon gyi bskal ba btang bar bsam/ thal ba lam rgya gram mam sa bdag klu gnyan gnas sar dong brus la mnan/ g.yam pas kha dag ba dgra bo 'khor bcas sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu song nas bskal bar mi thar bar bsam mo/ /las mjug 'phangs bsreg mnan pa gsum mo/ /sgrub khang yin na bca' gzhi bsdus la mi mngon par bya/ bkra shis brjod/ 'di ni drag sngags 'dus pa'i yang khol las/ /yang zab bcud bsdus gsal bar bkod pa ste/ /bstan pa'i snying po rnal 'byor bka' 'khor bcas/ /ma lus bsrung zhing mthu rtsal rgyas par shog / drag po sum sgril zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sna tshogs rang grol gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (12)zab mo yang tig gi bkang srung drag po sum sgril/ -PAGE 318--PAGE 317--PAGE 312-
